name: copy
description: Two overlapping rounded pages with a distinct foreground sheet in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The foreground is a solid rounded page with bounds 6.65..21.85 and radius-2.85 corners, exactly the exterior of the Outline foreground at Regular 1.70. The exposed rear border is authored as a closed width-1.70 band with outer radius 2.85, inner radius 1.15 and radius-.85 end caps. Its ends merge within the solid foreground; the exposed inter-page gap is retained. No artificial foreground hole is added. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.
